title: 4. Improve the preference list
heading: 4. Recommended similar programs
subtitle: Suggested programs
findSimilar: Find additional programs similar to the current wish list
methodBody: Suggestions combine similarity to the current list, approximate proximity, historical demand, estimated admission access and diversity between recommendations.
methodBodyAlt: Recommendations combine revealed preferences, proximity, portfolio-risk improvement, and a diversity step to avoid near-duplicates.
methodNote: Each suggestion is evaluated as if it were added at the end of the list and without any special priority. Adding it higher or declaring a real priority can change the result.
marginalNote: Each recommended program is evaluated as if it were appended after your current list. "Chance if considered" is conditional on you reaching that preference. The marginal unmatched-risk reduction is the current unmatched risk multiplied by that conditional chance; it is also the estimated final assignment chance for a program appended at the end. Projected unmatched risk is the current risk minus that reduction.
portfolioNote: Portfolio-risk estimates are marginal: they assume the program is appended after the current list. Reordering it higher would change final probabilities and should be tested by adding it to the wish list and rerunning the simulation.
priorityNote: Recommended programs assume no special priority flags for the newly added school. If you have a sibling, priority-student quota, civil-servant, former-student, or already-enrolled priority at that school, add the program to the list and mark the priority before rerunning the simulation.
strategicNote: Adding an acceptable program at the end does not reduce the chance of receiving a higher-ranked preference. After adding programs, verify priorities and analyze the list again.
selectHint: Select only programs you would genuinely accept. Recommendations are options to investigate, not automatic choices.

address.heading: Home address for distance calculation
address.label: Your home address
address.help: Optional. Used only to compute distance/proximity to recommended programs. If left empty, proximity is estimated from the current wish list. The address is geocoded with OpenStreetMap/Nominatim when you click the button.
address.hint: Enter an address, then click the button to compute recommendation distances from home instead of the current wish-list centroid.
address.intro: Enter a home address to measure distance from home. Otherwise, distance is estimated from the current preference list.
address.changed: Address changed. Click the button to update the coordinates.
address.confirmed: Distances will be computed from the confirmed address: {address}
address.privacyBody: The address is sent to OpenStreetMap/Nominatim only after you click the geocoding button. Distances remain approximate and do not represent travel time.

precision.approximate: The geocoded location is approximate. Distances should be interpreted carefully.
precision.city: The geocoder could only identify the city or municipality. Distances are approximate.
precision.streetNumberUnconfirmed: The geocoder found the street, but could not confirm the exact street number. Distances are computed from an approximate street-level location.
precision.street: The geocoder found the street, but not an exact address point. Distances are computed from an approximate street-level location.
precision.generic: The geocoder returned only an approximate location. Distances should be interpreted carefully.

distance.note: Distances are straight-line estimates. They do not represent road distance, travel time, or actual accessibility.
distance.coordsNote: Distances are straight-line estimates. School coordinates are preferred; commune and regional locations are approximate fallbacks.
distance.proximityNote: Proximity uses school-level coordinates when available. Commune and regional coordinates are only soft fallbacks and are never used for hard distance exclusion. To improve precision, add data/commune_coordinates.csv with commune, region, latitude, longitude.
distance.noHardFilter: Because the home location is only city-level or approximate, no hard distance cutoff is applied. Straight-line distance only affects the recommendation score.
distance.hardLimit: The {maxDistance} km straight-line limit is applied only when the program has reliable school-level coordinates. Commune and regional approximations are never used for hard exclusion.

card.chanceIfReached: Estimated chance if you reach this preference: {chance}
card.appendPreview: If appended at the end: estimated unmatched risk {current} → {projected}
card.why: Why it appears: it balances similarity to the current list, proximity and estimated admission safety.
card.add: Add this program to the end of my list
card.assumption: This estimate assumes the program is appended at the end and no special priority is declared.
card.riskLegend: Row colors reflect the projected unmatched risk after appending the program: green below the soft threshold ({soft}), orange between the soft and hard thresholds, and red at or above the hard threshold ({hard}).
